metadata.title: Notable cyber individuals (batch 2): leakers, malware authors, and the informant - plus the Mirai botnet
metadata.frame: Second batch of named, public-record cyber figures wired to their events/orgs, with graded dossiers in the Persons tab. Adds the Mirai IoT-botnet node (a major missing malware). Covers leakers (Manning, Schulte), malware authors (de Guzman/ILOVEYOU, Jha/Mirai), and the informant (Monsegur/Sabu).
metadata.grade: Convictions, sentences, and authorship = FACT (court records; on-record admissions). Behavioral assessments live in dossiers, labeled inference with calibrated confidence.
metadata.honest_limits: Public-record ROLE only in the graph; no private/biographical detail beyond what courts + on-record interviews establish (no doxxing). Inclusion is documentation, not additional accusation. Where a person has multiple convictions, they are stated factually and without sensationalism. Living people; excluded from the formal proofs.
metadata.method: DOJ/SDNY court records; US v. Manning (2013, commuted 2017); US v. Schulte (2022); US v. Jha (Mirai, 2017); on-record de Guzman interviews (2000/2020); US v. Monsegur.

edges.notes: Army intelligence analyst who leaked the Iraq/Afghan War Logs, Collateral Murder, and Cablegate to WikiLeaks (2010); convicted 2013 (35 yrs), sentence commuted by Obama (2017) (fact).
Former CIA software engineer convicted (2022) as the source of the Vault 7 leak to WikiLeaks - the largest data theft in CIA history (fact).
SDNY convicted Schulte on espionage-related counts for Vault 7; he also received a separate conviction on CSAM charges - both stated as court fact, without elaboration (fact).

The Manila college student who wrote the ILOVEYOU worm (2000); arrested but never charged (no applicable Philippine law), later confirmed authorship on record (2020) - the human at the origin of the law-lags-tech precedent (fact).
Co-author of the Mirai IoT botnet; pleaded guilty (2017) - originally built to attack Minecraft DDoS-protection markets before it escaped control (fact).

Mirai (2016) enslaved insecure IoT devices (default creds) into a massive DDoS botnet: it hit Krebs-on-Security, OVH, and - via Dyn (Oct-2016) - knocked out Twitter/Netflix/Reddit for much of the US East Coast. Its SOURCE CODE was released publicly, spawning endless variants - the IoT-botnet branch of the lineage (fact).
The Dyn DNS attack (Oct-21-2016) was a wake-up call on IoT insecurity + DNS as a single point of failure - feeding CISA/NIST IoT-security guidance (fact).
'Sabu' - a leader/hub of LulzSec (and Anonymous-adjacent AntiSec); after his 2011 arrest he became an FBI informant, and his cooperation led to the arrests of fellow members (fact).
The Sabu case is the canonical example of law enforcement flipping a hacktivist leader into an informant to dismantle a leaderless crew from within (fact).
